what: Skiff 2.6 with a song generator: one press writes a whole song in twelve styles, then you play its parts live from the keys. Moog, Oberheim and Juno filters, a towel-muted 70s drum kit, a tape-deck home screen with a creature for every sound, and an alchemist who conjures your song as it plays.
author: tammygucci
